test_cases.test_case_description: Verify LTE PS data transfer during mobility
acceptance_criteria: The device must maintain LTE PS data transfer while moving at 80 km/h.
Downlink throughput must exceed 60 Mbps during a 5-minute test.
No disconnections or packet loss during the test.

test_cases.test_case_description: Verify LTE PS data transfer at cell-edge conditions
acceptance_criteria: The device must maintain PS data transfer when RSRP drops to –110 dBm.
Downlink throughput must exceed 20 Mbps for 3 minutes at cell edge.
Packet loss must remain below 0.5% throughout the test.

test_cases.test_case_description: Verify LTE PS uplink throughput during mobility
acceptance_criteria: The device must maintain uplink throughput > 30 Mbps while moving at 80 km/h for 5 minutes.
Uplink latency must be below 50 ms.
No service interruptions or disconnections during the test.

test_cases.test_case_description: Verify seamless PS bearer handover between LTE cells
acceptance_criteria: Interruption time during handover must be less than 150 ms.
Downlink throughput must recover to > 60 Mbps within 1 second after handover.
No packet duplicates or loss above 1%.

test_cases.test_case_description: Verify LTE PS data transfer under peak network load
acceptance_criteria: Under simulated congestion, downlink throughput must exceed 15 Mbps.
End-to-end latency must remain below 100 ms.
No disconnections during the congestion period.

test_cases.test_case_description: Verify LTE PS PDP context re-establishment after radio link failure
acceptance_criteria: The device must re-establish PDP context within 2 seconds of a forced radio link failure.
Downlink throughput must exceed 40 Mbps within 1 minute after re-establishment.
No residual packet loss following re-establishment.

test_cases.test_case_description: Verify LTE PS data transfer after idle-mode resume
acceptance_criteria: The device must resume PS data transfer within 1 second of exiting idle mode.
Downlink throughput must exceed 10 Mbps immediately upon resume.
No missing or delayed data packets following resume.

test_cases.test_case_description: Verify 5G NR Band n79 connectivity during international roaming
acceptance_criteria: The device must connect to 5G NR Band n79 while roaming internationally.
Downlink throughput must exceed 200 Mbps during a 5-minute test.
No disconnections or performance degradation during the test.

test_cases.test_case_description: Verify LTE Band 2 performance for video streaming
acceptance_criteria: The device must connect to LTE Band 2.
The device must stream a 1080p video with no buffering for 5 minutes.
Downlink throughput must exceed 40 Mbps during the test.

test_cases.test_case_description: Verify device performance on 5G NR Band n14 for public safety
acceptance_criteria: The device must connect to 5G NR Band n14.
Downlink throughput must exceed 80 Mbps during a 5-minute test.
No disconnections during the test.

test_cases.test_case_description: Verify UMTS CS voice call initiation
acceptance_criteria: The device must initiate a UMTS CS voice call within 5 seconds.
Voice quality must meet a MOS of at least 3.0.
No call drops during a 2-minute test call.

test_cases.test_case_description: Verify GSM 900 band support for voice calls
acceptance_criteria: The device must connect to GSM 900 band.
The device must initiate a voice call with no errors.
Voice quality must meet a MOS of at least 3.0 during a 2-minute call.

test_cases.test_case_description: Verify LTE Band 40 connectivity during roaming
acceptance_criteria: The device must connect to LTE Band 40 while roaming.
No disconnections during a 15-minute test.
Downlink throughput must exceed 35 Mbps during the test.

No performance degradation during the test.

description: Made-Up Requirement: Dual SIM Support in LTE

test_cases.test_case_description: Verify dual SIM functionality for LTE data and voice
acceptance_criteria: The device must support LTE data on SIM 1 while making a voice call on SIM 2.
Data throughput on SIM 1 must exceed 50 Mbps during the call.
Voice quality on SIM 2 must meet a MOS of at least 3.5.

acceptance_criteria: The device must activate an eSIM profile for 5G SA connectivity.
